title: Layout of the final work tape
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine and $D$ a configuration with one work tape, both on the same input. Let $ct:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\Gamma)$ and $cp\in\mathbb Z$. If $D$ and $c$ have the same input-head position and output, then embedding $D$'s sole work tape as the last tape among the $k+1$ tapes, using $c$'s tapes and head positions for the first $k$ tapes, yields the clock configuration built from $c$, with state and clock tape taken from $D$.
hypotheses_covered: Configurations $c$ and $D$ share the same input
